Use the installed Evidence Lab citation-management capability to normalize the
file `/workspace/citation-probe-input.bib`. Locate `format_bibtex.py` only in
the installed Evidence Lab plugin cache; do not read or execute anything from a
source or release checkout. Then run one final shell command that invokes that
installed script with `/workspace/citation-probe-input.bib --output
/workspace/citation-probe-output.bib --rekey --deduplicate --sort key`, adds
`>/dev/null 2>&1`, and, only if the formatter succeeds, uses `cat
/workspace/citation-probe-output.bib` in the same command. Return that final
command output without rewriting it.
